'''Carl Mosik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hunter living on the [[Rryatt Trail]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. He was an active, undercover member of the Wookiee resistance, a group against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] endorsement of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavery of the Wookiee people of Kashyyyk.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Carl Mosik appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
